xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
In the financial statements, Profit Before Tax (PBT) is arrived at after deducting both “Profit before exceptional items, share of profit of equity accounted investee and income tax” and “Profit before exceptional items and income tax.”
However, in the XBRL format, the line item “Share of profit of equity accounted investee” appears after the line item “Profit before tax.”
Accordingly, for the purpose of the Cash Flow Statement, we are required to consider the PBT as per the financial statements, i.e., Rs. 168.50 crores. Due to technical limitations in the XBRL utility, we have clubbed the Exceptional Items and Share of Profit of Equity Accounted Investee to arrive at the PBT figure of Rs. 168.50 crores.
